# Ardhya Novri Ramadhan — Engineering Portfolio (ardhyanovri.my.id)

Focused on embedded systems (STM32, ESP32, C/C++), digital signal processing (EMG acquisition & IIR/FIR filtering), industrial instrumentation, systems programming (Rust, Python, Swift/Metal, Node.js), and verified web engineering.
